sections.description:

Facebook | YouTube

Flow Widget setup video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MmpP7DG9jqo

Key Features:

  • Quick setup — install and start chatting in minutes
  • AI chatbot handles FAQs, human agents handle complex conversations
  • Mobile-responsive chat widget for desktop, tablet, and mobile
  • Real-time messaging with website visitors
  • Visitor monitoring and proactive chat
  • Multi-language support
  • WooCommerce compatible
  • GDPR compliant
  • Free trial available

Chat Widget & Design

  • Mobile-responsive design
  • Multiple widget styles

AI Chatbot Automation

  • Seamless handoff to human agents

Agent Dashboard

  • Real-time notifications
  • Chat history and transcripts
  • Unlimited agents
  • Team collaboration tools

Visitor Engagement

  • Real-time visitor monitoring
  • Proactive chat invitations
  • Offline message capture
  • Lead generation forms

Integrations & Compatibility

  • WooCommerce ready
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • Lightweight and fast loading
  • GDPR compliant
  • SSL secure

Use Cases

  • Online Stores — Add live chat to WooCommerce product pages and checkout
  • SaaS Businesses — Provide real-time product support
  • Agencies — White label live chat for client websites
  • Small Businesses — Affordable live chat for startups
  • Support Teams — Manage support conversations in one dashboard

How It Works

IMsupporting combines AI chatbot technology with human agents:

  • AI chatbot answers common questions automatically
  • Live agents handle complex conversations
  • Seamless handoff between AI and humans
  • Unlimited conversations on the free trial

sections.installation:
Install IMsupporting Live Chat

  1. Search for “IMsupporting” in the WordPress plugins directory and install
  2. Activate the plugin
  3. Go to Settings > IMsupporting Chat and create a free account or enter your Account ID
  4. Your live chat widget appears on your site automatically

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins menu
  4. Configure settings at Settings > IMsupporting Chat

Need help? Contact support at imsupporting.com
sections.faq:
Is IMsupporting live chat free?

A free trial is available with no credit card required. Premium features including AI training, analytics, and integrations are available on paid plans.

How does the AI chatbot work?

The AI chatbot handles frequently asked questions automatically, providing instant responses. When a conversation requires human expertise, the AI transfers the chat to a live agent.

Can I use this with WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin is compatible with WooCommerce. You can add live chat to product pages, checkout, and shopping cart.

Do I need coding skills?

No coding is required. Install the plugin, enter your Account ID, and the chat widget appears on your site. Customize colors and position from the dashboard.

Can I customize the chat widget?

Yes. You can customize colors, position, welcome message, agent photos, and branding from the dashboard.

Is the chat widget mobile responsive?

Yes. Both the visitor-facing widget and the agent dashboard work on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

How many agents can use the live chat?

You can add unlimited agents at no extra cost.

What happens when agents are offline?

Visitors can leave offline messages. The AI chatbot continues answering common questions when agents are unavailable.

Will this slow down my WordPress site?

The chat widget is lightweight and loads asynchronously, so it does not affect page load speed.

Is this plugin GDPR compliant?

Yes. The plugin includes data protection and privacy features for GDPR compliance.

What is the difference between AI chatbot and live chat?

The AI chatbot uses automation to answer questions based on trained responses. Live chat connects visitors with human agents in real time. IMsupporting combines both.

Can I try it before upgrading?

Yes. A free trial is available with no credit card required.
